text:
nora: Heads-up: Compliance wants deterministic provenance for audit downloads + a visible routing state in the console. Proposal: small status pill per export row: [DEDICATED] [HOSTED] [FALLBACK]. Click -> show routing_reason (rule_id) + TTL. Also add export_sla_class (standard|high|legal) so we can prioritize dedicated pool scheduling.

tarek: export_sla_class is smart. We should map legal -> always route to Dedicated unless tenant opts out. For high, try Dedicated first then hosted if capacity low. For standard, hosted unless PII.

vikram: Telemetry: include fields routing_decision, rule_id, sla_class, fallback_used (true/false). Expose metric: dedicated_sla_violation_count and export_latency_by_sla. Keep full payload retention opt-in.

ops: Ops needs alerts: dedicated_sla_violation_count > 0 for >1m -> page. Also track per-pool headroom percentage. We prefer headroom <15% to trigger autoscale.

legal-bot: legal: for court requests we need NDJSON export with minimal PII + proof_hash and signer metadata. Signed proof should not include the full payload.

nora: UX: pill color mapping (green=DEDICATED, blue=HOSTED, amber=FALLBACK). Kebab menu -> "Export audit bundle" (NDJSON) and "Routing timeline". Also show "signed_proof_available" flag.

tarek: API: POST /v1/exports?sla=legal returns 202 + { export_id, poll_url }. If Dedicated capacity available it will start, otherwise fallback presigned flow. Poll returns status + signed_proof when ready.

vikram: Action items: 1) I'll add telemetry fields + metric dashboards (ETA 2d). 2) Tarek to spec poll contract + presigned metadata (ETA 3d). 3) Nora to mock UI pill + drawer (ETA 1w). 4) Ops to add alerts/runbook (ETA 1d).

nora: Also will add per-tenant opt-in for full payload retention and an admin toggle to force-route to Dedicated if under legal hold. Closing unless questions.
